documents.name: Heureka
documents.summary: Heureka is a science discovery destination in Vantaa, retained for distinctive visitor-experience quality.
documents.whyWorthwhile: Finland’s flagship interactive science centre remains unusually experiment-led and accessible across school ages.

audience.notes: Editorial destination-fit profile derived from the researched positive age span. Bands without positive evidence remain unknown rather than being treated as a positive match or a hard prohibition. Individual rides and activities may have stricter operator rules.

documents.name: Moominworld
documents.summary: Moominworld is a story park destination in Naantali, retained for distinctive visitor-experience quality.
documents.whyWorthwhile: A highly specific, walk-through Moomin story world that excels for preschool and younger school-age children rather than chasing thrill rides.
